in_marathi.name: Liena
in_marathi.long_meaning: Liena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Liena is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lila' meaning 'play' or 'pastime'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower is a symbol of purity, divinity, and enlightenment. The name Liena reflects the divine and spiritual essence of the lotus.
